title: Cybernetic Genesis — Shared $defs (L0 source-canon primitives)
description: Reusable definitions that bake in the L0 covenant: dual-witness, boundary-stone content addressing, and weights-&-measures. Referenced by every other schema in the pack.

ContentHash.$comment: Boundary stone (Deut 19:14 / Prov 22:28): immutable content address. Do not move the ancient landmark.

Ref.$comment: An opaque reference id to another governed object (policy, memory, provenance, evidence).

Witness.$comment: One attestation. type=chart => a signer/identity witness; type=method => a validator/method witness.

Witnesses.$comment: Dual witness (Deut 19:15): a matter is established by two or three witnesses. Never one.

WitnessesDualType.$comment: Stronger form: not just two witnesses, but two of DIFFERENT kind — at least one chart AND one method. A signer alone, or two validators alone, does not establish the matter.

Measurement.$comment: Weights & measures (Lev 19:35-36 / Prov 11:1): a just weight declares its terms. Every metric states sample_size, snr (number or explicit 'n/a'), and units.

Governance.$comment: ESTATE INTEGRATION: this is the SocioProphet/semantic-serdes governance block, reused verbatim so a Genesis object carries the same admission discipline as an AgentMessage / SemanticCell. admissibility_tier + review_status enums are the semantic-serdes canonical_enums (no drift). A Genesis object without governance is a fork; with it, it consumes the estate contract.

TruthClass.$comment: ESTATE INTEGRATION: semantic-serdes canonical truth_class. A Hologram is a semantic claim, so it declares HOW it is known — the same vocabulary a SemanticCell uses.

ConsentGrant.$comment: The Ring/three-space stack governs model serving + updates for OPTED-IN users ONLY. Consent is purpose-bound and fail-closed: anything that is not an explicit `opted_in` is not consent. `not_asked` is the default posture, never an implied yes.

purpose.$comment: Purpose-bound: consent is for THIS purpose, and does not generalise.

Membrane.$comment: The twin bridge is a MEMBRANE, not a pipe. A single 1-space system in which the AI connects to and PROTECTS the user's three-space system from the external three-space system. Flow direction is declared, not assumed; `bidirectional` is the only direction that lets the external space reach the user space, and it is gated on the sealed thresholds (see Twin's threshold rule).

external_space.$comment: The three-space system being protected FROM.

flow.$comment: inbound = external->user (read into the protected space). outbound = user->external. bidirectional = both, and requires a full threshold crossing.

thresholds_crossed.$comment: The hermetically-sealed thresholds of the topic space. The space is 22. 21 is SHORT — seen, not crossed. Bidirectional flow requires all 22.

scale.$comment: The INCEPTION->GENESYS bridge repeats at each scale: stand up the k3s quorum, the twin bridge scales to k8s, and repeats again for the federated global mesh. One bridge, three frequencies.

EstimatedShortfall.$comment: M.OS.ES — Model-OS Estimated Shortfall. A measured handicap on the authoring device: how far its assurance falls below what direct authorship demands. A constrained device (mobile, ephemeral) does not get to author on its own word. The covenant already allows for this — 'two or three witnesses' — so a device carrying a shortfall must make it up with a +1 attestation: a THIRD witness, independent of the chart+method pair. Shortfall 0 authors directly; shortfall > 0 authors only attested; a shortfall that cannot be made up is refused. This is the same shape as the 22-threshold: falling short is not a veto on the work, it is a demand that someone else cross with you.

device_class.$comment: sealed_host = attested boot + sealed key custody; workstation = operator-controlled; mobile = constrained custody; ephemeral = no durable custody.

estimated_shortfall.$comment: 0.0 = meets the bar for direct authorship. > 0 = short by that fraction, and the +1 is required.

plus_one.$comment: The +1: the third, independent witness that makes up the shortfall. Not a re-signature by the same party — it must be a different witness kind than the one the device itself supplies.

allOf.$comment: A device that falls short may NOT author directly. The handicap is the point.
Authoring while short is permitted ONLY with the +1 actually present.
